name: House and Cloister Garden
summary: This scene illustrates the integration of architectural design with landscape elements. It showcases a house positioned alongside a cloister-style garden, demonstrating how built structures can define and complement natural spaces. The inclusion of potted roses within the garden highlights the use of specific flora to add detail and focal points, emphasizing the deliberate design choices in creating a harmonious living environment.

objects.label: House
objects.description: A simple representation of a dwelling, providing context and scale for the adjacent garden space. Its solid form contrasts with the open area of the garden.

objects.label: Garden
objects.description: A cloister-style garden, providing a structured and serene space adjacent to the house. Its large, open design is typical of enclosed courtyards.

objects.label: Roses
objects.description: Potted roses add a touch of color and life to the garden. This element serves as a decorative focal point within the larger garden structure.
